title: Source: build/runtime
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: build/runtime

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/init.py

Python · Tier A

Dispatch the compiled Server/Gateway bootstrap using bundled metadata and an explicitly supplied application root. Route read-only queries, maintenance and dependency setup before transferring to the chosen runtime; configure compiled module paths for application and worker subprocesses. The inference-portal role delegates to its own bootstrap. This module selects owners rather than implementing their storage, update or service protocols.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
configure 38 Validate the compiled backend marker, install explicit runtime metadata on sys, prepend bundled modules and disable bytecode writes. Set the default shared browser root without overwriting an existing choice. This does not independently verify image authenticity or install dependencies.
worker 63 Configure the selected image, preserve caller arguments and invoke the named worker. Handle installation checks, file-finder lookup, jobs and owned terminals through their dedicated entry points; known package prefixes use main and other modules use runpy. This dispatcher is not a module allowlist or an authorization boundary.
worker_command 87 Build isolated UTF-8 Python argv using the embedded worker bootstrap and bundled module path. Preserve each argument as its own string; return argv without launching a subprocess or joining through a shell.
main 106 Create invocation-local setup approval/output policy for ordinary bootstrap and maintenance calls. Map cancellation to 130 and selected setup exceptions to 1; internal application execution bypasses this setup wrapper so application logging and error handling retain control.
_main 154 Parse bootstrap flags while preserving application arguments, select role/instance and route legal display, auth, help, maintenance and status. For ordinary launch, check preflight/service constraints, serialize registration and dependency selection, then exec on POSIX or wait for a Windows child. Internal application mode restores recorded runtime context, invokes update recovery and enters the application owner.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/common.py

Python · Tier A

Supply standard-library setup primitives for pinned inputs, private storage, receipts and shared installation locking. Callers choose trusted metadata, installation intent and staging paths; these helpers validate individual operations without performing the complete dependency workflow. Atomic replacement publishes verified downloads/JSON, but these helpers do not fsync a durable checkpoint.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
digest 31 Read one file and return its SHA-256 hex digest. This verifies bytes against a caller-supplied pin; it does not establish the provenance of that expected pin.
identity 38 Hash deterministic compact, sorted-key JSON to identify a dependency/profile value. Inputs must be JSON serializable; no file or environment state is read.
write_json 47 Create the receipt parent if needed, write sorted indented JSON to a sibling temporary file and replace the destination atomically. Always remove the temporary name; no fsync or cross-file transaction is performed.
private_directory 63 Reject symlink components, create the final directory and, on POSIX, require current-user ownership and mode 0700. Delegate mismatches to the active scoped repair owner or propagate refusal. Return an absolute path; Windows skips these POSIX ownership/mode checks.
data_root 81 Choose the compiled installation data root by explicit absolute SMTO_COMPILED_HOME or platform conventions. Return a path only; validation/creation happens separately. The download cache uses its own root.
cache_root 96 Choose the platform download-cache location from LOCALAPPDATA, macOS Library/Caches or XDG/default cache home. This resolver does not create storage or inherit the compiled data-root override.
interpreter 107 Prefer the platform virtual-environment interpreter, then known embedded-runtime alternatives. If none exists, return the preferred candidate for the caller to diagnose; existence here does not verify ABI or executability.
run 123 Forward command arguments, environment, directory, capture and timeout to the invocation output owner. Confirmation and command selection remain the caller responsibility.
download 133 Require a lowercase SHA-256 pin and HTTPS URL, then reuse only matching nonsymlink cached bytes. Offline cache misses fail. Online transfers use temporary files, reject insecure final redirects and verify the digest before replacement; only OSError/TimeoutError receives up to three attempts with short backoff. Digest/redirect validation failures propagate immediately.
extract 190 Create the destination, prevalidate ZIP names and reject ZIP symlinks before extraction; delegate TAR member/link/device checks to the standard data filter. Extraction is not an atomic publication and may leave partial output after an I/O failure; staging cleanup belongs to the caller.
installation_lock 218 Open a regular single-link lock file inside a private directory and acquire a nonblocking OS lock, retrying every two seconds until the monotonic deadline. Yield while holding it, always unlock/close on exit, and leave the lock file reusable; Windows locks one initialized byte while POSIX uses flock.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/installer.py

Python · Tier A

Prepare dependency generations for a compiled application while keeping first-party modules in the application image. Resolve a profile identity, reuse a core-ready environment or resume a pending generation, install pinned Python inputs and native prerequisites, then publish a ready/partial receipt after mandatory checks. Custom runtimes receive ABI/core checks without dependency replacement. Failed attempts retain progress and earlier published environments; platform commands and optional feature checks have separate failure policies.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
profile 41 Read the bundled nonempty schema-v1 dependency lock and hash it together with any bundled system/native download recipes. Return the Python lock plus combined identity; changed native inputs select a different environment namespace. Parsing and identity do not authenticate these already-bundled inputs.
environment_status 60 Read the profile receipt without creating storage or probing dependencies. With no published receipt, expose a pending generation log when present; otherwise report not-installed. Preserve published state while attaching pending_setup diagnostics. Malformed or unreadable records propagate instead of being silently repaired.
status_with_sizes 94 Add observed file-byte totals for shared runtimes, environments, applications, browsers, tools and downloads to dependency status. Skip symlink files; these live recursive measurements are not an atomic snapshot or allocated-disk accounting, and filesystem errors propagate.
configure_environment 126 Set this process shared browser root and prepend the chosen interpreter plus recorded native directories to PATH. Include private Windows client locations and use a recorded browser only when BROWSER_PATH is unset. This changes the process environment, not persistent shell configuration.
pip_environment 151 Copy the environment while removing inherited Python/pip/Conda settings and compiler/linker overrides, then disable pip configuration/version checks, bytecode and configure-site overrides. Proxy and TLS environment choices survive; this is subprocess configuration hygiene, not a sandbox.
pip_command 191 Build isolated, no-bytecode pip argv with the shared pip cache and optional SSL_CERT_FILE. Append caller operations without execution; installation restrictions are supplied by install_wheels or the source-build caller.
requirements 210 Serialize supplied package URLs and SHA-256 pins into pip requirement lines with a final newline. This formatter neither downloads inputs nor validates their provenance.
install_wheels 220 Skip an empty package group; otherwise write a package-identity requirement file and run pip with hashes, binary-only inputs, no index, no dependency resolution and no bytecode. Direct pinned URLs may still require network access. Command failure propagates to the mandatory or optional caller.
native_paths 244 Discover existing platform client directories for the current installation: private Linux tools, known macOS manager/client prefixes, or Windows registry/program paths. Deduplicate directories in discovery order; presence does not establish executable readiness.
ensure_venv 289 Create or repair the unpublished environment in place when its completion marker or interpreter is absent. Write the marker only after venv succeeds, so an interrupted creation retries even if an interpreter file already exists.
build_source 303 Allow only PyGObject, pycairo and gssapi source builds. Bootstrap a separately pinned build environment, reuse verified source bytes and prior local build receipts, select native compilers and require exactly one produced wheel. Record its actual hash and upstream source hash; subprocess failures retain resumable work rather than publishing a ready dependency generation.
ready_environment 371 Perform a read-only reuse check: a ready/partial profile receipt must point inside its environment namespace and contain an interpreter plus matching core marker. Return None when those checks fail; this is not a fresh feature audit or complete integrity check, and malformed records still raise.
installation_needed 391 Return true for explicit repair, or for an absent managed-ready environment when no custom runtime was supplied. A custom selection suppresses this managed check but is validated later by ensure_environment.
ensure_environment 399 Reject elevated application execution before reuse or repairs. Return a warm managed environment when eligible; otherwise obtain invocation acceptance and enable narrowly scoped directory repairs before entering custom or managed setup. This wrapper does not grant blanket elevation to pip.
_ensure_environment 446 Validate a custom interpreter ABI/core capability or serialize managed setup under the dependency lock. Resume only a pending generation in the current profile namespace, run staged installs/checks and publish BOM, core marker and receipts. Record optional failures as partial; mandatory failures update the generation log and propagate. Publication spans several files and is not a cross-file transaction.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/interaction.py

Python · Tier A

Keep compiled-setup approval and output policy local to the current invocation/context. Bind legal-document versions/hashes through the shared installation owner, remember approval within the session and restore outer state on exit. Command execution supports machine capture, verbose progress and retained quiet failure logs; callers still decide when a command is authorized.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Session 22 Carry this invocation approval, verbosity, noninteractive choice and configured legal options. This is transient context state, not a persisted acceptance receipt.
AdministratorOperationFailed 32 A graphical administrator operation must be retried before setup completes.
session 39 Install a fresh ContextVar session and yield it, then restore the previous context even on failure. Nested invocation approval/output choices do not overwrite their parent session.
current 49 Return this context current installation session, or None outside a session; no implicit session is created.
note 55 Print progress outside setup sessions or when the current invocation is verbose. Quiet setup suppresses these optional messages, not explicit errors or consent prompts.
progress 60 Keep setup stages visible without mixing progress into machine-readable stdout.
confirm 73 Reuse approval already held by the current session. Otherwise require configured legal context, show the data root and delegate acceptance to the shared legal owner; mark approved only after that owner succeeds.
configure_legal 92 Validate explicit acceptance flags and bind component/version options to the current session. When native installation approval is being reused, require its recorded document version/content-hash identity to match the bundled documents. This function configures acceptance but does not itself prompt or install.
run 120 Execute an argv list without a shell, with check=True and the requested environment/directory/timeout. Ordinary/verbose mode routes output to stderr or capture; quiet mode logs diagnostics privately, removes successful logs and retains logs for OS/subprocess failures. Quiet sudo authentication runs visibly before adding -n to the actual command. This output adapter does not independently call confirm.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_deferred.py

Python · Tier A

Finish removal of a Windows launcher that cannot be deleted while its invoking process holds it open. Persist the selected manifests under the temporary maintenance runtime, detach a helper to wait for the parent, update registry/removal status and arrange deletion of that temporary runtime afterward. This finalizer is Windows-specific and does not independently recreate the original user confirmation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
schedule 25 Write selected manifests, parent PID and data/cache roots to deferred.json in the maintenance directory. Spawn an isolated detached Windows helper outside the current job with no inherited stdio. Remove the plan if spawn fails; success means scheduling, not completed removal.
main 62 Read the deferred plan, restore roots and wait for the parent handle when available. Under operation and gate locks, remove selected manifests without interactive elevation and save registry progress. Record complete or retryable pending status, then spawn PowerShell to remove only the temporary helper directory after this process exits. A zero return does not itself prove every removal succeeded; inspect removal.json.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_privilege.py

Python · Tier A

Retry a caller-selected maintenance manifest through an isolated OS-authorized helper when ordinary permissions are insufficient. Carry the invoking data/cache roots and original identities into bounded removal, snapshot or backup operations, then return structured results. OS authorization and caller plan selection remain separate; partial filesystem work is not rolled back on failure.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
elevated_main 26 Read the helper plan, restore its data/cache roots and execute bounded backup, snapshot or removal. Recheck data-root identities for backup/snapshot; write result JSON or an error result and status 1. Backup transfers archive ownership/access back to the invoking account. Failures before the operation handler may leave no result.
remove_with_elevation 75 Try ordinary manifest removal first and retry through the elevated helper only on PermissionError. The first attempt can already have removed entries; manifest-based missing- entry handling supports the retry. Other errors propagate without elevation.
snapshot_with_elevation 87 Try ordinary path inventory and use the elevated snapshot helper only for PermissionError. The helper then checks the approved data directory identity; other inventory failures propagate.
elevated_operation 101 Write a private temporary plan and run an isolated helper through sudo or Windows UAC, preserving selected roots and manifest scope. Unattended POSIX uses sudo -n; Windows elevation requires interactive UAC. Require a successful structured result, and copy a returned backup through the exclusive private-archive owner. Temporary plan/output files are cleaned on exit; no operation rollback is implied.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_runtime.py

Python · Tier A

Associate a compiled role/instance with its current process, native supervisor and process group. Compare fresh OS identity observations before accepting a running marker or signaling shutdown, and provide recorded runtime environment defaults. Ordinary stops wait for exit; a saved update can request verified escalation of retained service identities. A PID alone never establishes ownership.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
process_identity 27 Observe OS process identity using Linux start ticks and executable, Windows creation time/image, or ps start/command output elsewhere. Treat Linux zombies and handled lookup errors as absent. Equality reduces PID-reuse mistakes but observation is not an atomic signal handle.
marker_path 94 Derive the role/instance process marker under .lifecycle/processes. Validate the registry key through the shared store and return a path without writing it.
running_identity 105 Read a checked marker and return it only when its saved application-process identity equals a fresh OS observation. Missing/stale markers return None; malformed JSON or fields may still raise. Supervisor/group validity is checked separately before signaling.
running 121 Under the operation lock, reject a matching live instance and publish application/supervisor/group identities plus resource references. Release the lock while the application runs. On exit, remove only a marker still matching this context, without reacquiring the lock that maintenance may hold during shutdown.
stop 151 Ignore an absent/stale application marker; otherwise revalidate its supervisor, and on Windows its process group, before requesting graceful shutdown. Send POSIX SIGTERM or a disposable Windows CTRL_BREAK helper, then wait for the original supervisor identity to disappear. Refuse changed ownership; ordinary stops fail on timeout. An updater with a successful durable save may request bounded escalation using the retained process identities.
apply 230 Set recorded environment defaults only where the current process has no value, then change to the recorded working directory. Existing explicit environment choices survive; an invalid directory raises and prior environment assignments are not rolled back.
default_environment 239 Construct role-specific default state/TLS paths, plus Gateway instance/job/browser/artifact/lease locations, under the supplied data path. Return a mapping without creating directories or changing this process.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_store.py

Python · Tier A

Own compiled-installation registry paths, process-compatible locks and recorded resource inventories. Track original directory entries and identities so backup/removal can reject replacements and preserve later additions. The lifecycle orchestrator chooses approved resources and shared references; this module enforces individual path/entry operations, not a whole uninstall transaction or content-based modification policy.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
key 26 Validate a Server/Gateway role and a one-to-sixty-four-character lowercase instance name, then return role:instance. This stable registry key is distinct from resource identity and process identity.
directory 34 Return the absolute .lifecycle directory under the selected compiled data root without creating it. Individual readers/writers apply path and permission checks separately.
check_path 42 Make a path absolute, reject parent traversal and reject existing symlink/reparse components. Optionally permit only the final component to be a link so recorded links can be removed without following them. Missing components are allowed; this is a point-in-time check rather than a held directory handle.
fingerprint 59 Return lstat device/inode identity for the path itself, including a link. This detects replacement, not in-place content changes or file integrity.
load 67 Read the nonlinked registry, requiring private current-user POSIX ownership and schema-v1 dictionary sections. Return an empty in-memory registry when absent without creating storage. Malformed, unsupported or unsafe records fail instead of being silently reset.
save 87 Require a private lifecycle directory and atomically replace registry JSON. The caller owns locking and schema correctness; this helper does not provide a multi-file transaction or fsync guarantee.
lock 97 Hold a shared or exclusive OS lock compatible with native-launcher lifecycle locks. Require a private regular single-link file, poll nonblocking acquisition every 50 ms until its deadline and release on every scope exit. Long maintenance waits emit one progress message; the reusable lock file remains.
snapshot 150 Recursively record names, entry kinds, device/inode identities and regular-file byte sizes in deterministic order. Record links without descending through them and reject special file types. This inventory is not an atomic filesystem snapshot and contains no content hashes by itself.
allowed_resource 189 Require a checked path strictly beneath the category-specific application/runtime/environment/launcher/browser/tool/cache/data/receipt root. Reject unknown categories and the category root itself. This boundary check does not prove registration, consent or exclusive ownership.
track 213 Ignore absent resources; otherwise derive a path-based ID and preserve existing inventory. Rebind previously inventoried tools only to checksum-verified identical replacements. For a new root identity, snapshot entries and hash immutable application/runtime/launcher files plus verified tools. Publish the manifest; saving the caller registry remains a separate step.
resource_manifest 267 Validate the resource boundary and return a legacy embedded inventory or load its separate manifest. Require separate manifest path/category/root identity to match the registry; entry validation happens when consumed.
validate_entry 281 Require a relative manifest name without traversal, allow only a recorded leaf link and compare its current device/inode. Return None for a missing entry so interrupted removal can resume; replacement raises. Recorded SHA-256 values are not checked by this identity helper.
open_recorded_file 302 Open only the recorded regular backup file, verifying descriptor identity before yielding bytes. On POSIX, walk no-follow directory descriptors and verify the approved root when encountered; Windows uses path checks and final file identity. Always close handles; this does not freeze file contents against concurrent writes.
remove_manifest 342 Prevalidate all recorded entry identities, then remove them in reverse inventory order with repeated checks. Pin POSIX parent descriptors; unlink recorded links, skip already-missing entries and retain nonempty directories containing later additions. Replacement or other failures abort after any completed deletions; same-inode content edits do not exempt a recorded file.
selected 407 Return sorted installation/retained-data names for one validated role/instance or the full union when all_roles is requested. This chooses registry keys only; shared resource protection is calculated by the lifecycle orchestrator.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/permissions.py

Python · Tier A

Repair only the requested POSIX installation directory inside an explicitly enabled setup scope. User-owned mode repair needs no elevation; otherwise a terminal prompt and sudo run a fixed isolated helper that checks the original directory identity. Reverify ownership/mode/link boundaries afterward. Contents and parent directories are not recursively repaired, and inactive scopes refuse repairs.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
directory_repairs 53 Enable directory repair with this invocation interactive/noninteractive policy and restore the prior ContextVar on every exit. An inactive scope differs from an enabled noninteractive scope, which can still repair user-owned mode bits.
repair_directory 66 Require an active scope. Try user-owned chmod first, then verify; otherwise require interactive terminal input, an available sudo and explicit approval before invoking the unchanged isolated helper. Translate launch failures and reject unsuccessful post-repair identity/owner/mode checks. Never run a recursive ownership change.
verify_directory 145 Recheck every path component for symlinks, then require the original device/inode, a directory type, current-user ownership and mode 0700. A successful subprocess exit alone is insufficient proof of repair.

build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/system.py

Python · Tier A

Provision platform prerequisites and private command-line clients for compiled setup. Select an available package manager, install configured recipes, and record package/client evidence; callers own consent and the overall dependency transaction. Private Docker extraction selects client executables, and the MacPorts fallback builds only PostgreSQL client targets. System package effects are external to generation receipts and are not rolled back by a failed setup.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
browser_packages 35 Accept only package names from Playwright's dry-run, never execute its shell text.
macos_manager 50 Search normal and Finder-missing manager directories, preferring Homebrew over MacPorts. Prepend the selected executable directory to process PATH and return its manager name, or None; provisioning a missing manager is a separate install branch.
postgres_clients 70 Reuse a pinned private PostgreSQL client build only when its receipt-listed files still match. Otherwise re-extract verified upstream source, build client targets with MacPorts libraries, require the exact expected binary set and record file/version/license evidence. Failed builds may leave staging output; no database service is configured.
inventory_clients 164 Resolve available client executables, hash their bytes and collect bounded local version/help output with exit codes. Probe failures become evidence, while initial file hashing errors propagate; these observations neither contact a service nor guarantee that later operations succeed.
private_windows_clients 206 Copy only pinned Docker client/plugin inputs into private tool directories, selecting a named ZIP member when configured. Populate per-user plugin discovery only when the target name is absent, preserving an existing customer plugin; record private executable hashes and discovery paths separately.
private_linux_clients 249 On x86_64, keep working Docker/Buildx clients and Compose v2; download pinned replacements for missing or insufficient commands. Extract exactly one regular docker/docker member, atomically replace each private executable and prepend its directory to process PATH. Return receipts for newly supplied clients; probe/transfer errors propagate.
elevation 309 Return no prefix for Windows or an already-root POSIX process; otherwise require sudo and add -n for unattended use. This selects argv only and does not authenticate or authorize the surrounding operation.
windows_installer 321 Find the package recipe, verify/download its pinned installer and copy it to a digest-specific cache. Run directly for noninteractive use or request ShellExecute runas and wait up to thirty minutes interactively. Reject nonzero/unfinished outcomes and close the handle; timeout does not terminate an installer still running.
install 399 Read platform recipes and return failed-step descriptions plus installation receipts. Skip reports an explicit partial condition; platform branches provision managers/clients and continue after handled package failures. Some malformed metadata or unexpected errors still propagate. Package changes are immediate OS effects, not rolled back with dependency generations.
